text:
Tara (Sales): Quick ask — NovaApps POC needs short-term autoscale uplift on dedicated pool dp-91. They expect a large daytime spike and want +4 GPUs headroom for a 30h window starting 2024-11-15T10:00Z. Also need 2 scoped API keys for their SREs and a one-off POC credit. Can infra and finance confirm?
Ben (Solutions): Do we have expected concurrency, model, and typical seq length? Also: do they want reservation (guaranteed) or burst (best-effort)?
Jordan (Client-SRE): We'll run redwood-rw-30b-quant, ~300 concurrent, avg seq 768. Prefer guaranteed reservation for the demo to avoid surprises.
Ivy (EngInfra): We can create a reservation for +4 GPUs. That will hard-cap those GPUs to the account for the window. API example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/pools/dp-91/reservations -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"reservation_name":"nova-poc-20241115","gpus":4,"start_time":"2024-11-15T10:00:00Z","end_time":"2024-11-16T16:00:00Z","hard_cap":true}'
Ivy (EngInfra): Autoscaler settings suggestion: keep autoscale-window=60s, cooldown=5m, and set a max_inflight to prevent burst spikes; we also recommend enabling prefix KV cache for repeated prompts to reduce token costs.
Sam (Security): For keys: only pool-scoped actions (submit, logs, metrics) allowed. Keys must be IP-allowlisted and TTL <= 72h. We'll open a temporary access entry and require deletion proof after.
Finance Bot: Estimate: 4 GPUs * 30h = 120 GPU-hrs. At $4.80/GPU-hr => $576. We can apply a $600 POC credit to cover this if approved.
Ben (Solutions): Add a fallback routing rule to route lower-priority traffic to redwood-rw-13b-quant if the pool climbs above 85% utilization. That keeps interactive latency stable.
Ivy (EngInfra): Creating reservation and keys now. CLI for keys: rdw iam create-key --service-account nova-poc-sre --scopes "dedicated:pool:dp-91" --expires-in 72h --allowed-ips "198.51.100.64/28"
Deploy Bot: Job queued jb-20241030-901. Applying reservation to dp-91.
Deploy Bot: Reservation applied ✅ reservation-id rv-nova-20241115-01. Scoped keys created: nova-poc-sre-01, nova-poc-sre-02 (expire 2024-11-18T10:00:00Z). Audit ticket AT-802 opened. Console events: https://console.redwood.ai/pools/dp-91/events/jb-20241030-901
Jordan (Client-SRE): Keys validated and smoke tests run — p50=260ms, p95=620ms. Looks good.
Tara (Sales): Great. I'll confirm POC credit and send the reservation + key rotation notes to the customer. Reminder from infra: request extension minimum 6h before end_time with justification.
Ivy (EngInfra): Post-demo: we'll revoke keys and attach audit logs. If they need a follow-up demo with a longer window, plan for a formal reservation and billing commit.
Sam (Security): Security checklist posted to the ticket. Approved pending allowlist + audit capture.
Tara (Sales): Closing loop — thanks everyone :tada:
